description: Sanskritree corpus — clean IAST texts discovered through GRETIL/SARIT discovery methodology
methodology: Before OCRing any text, check GRETIL, SARIT, Sanskrit Documents, and Ambuda. Most 'unavailable' texts exist as clean digital IAST.

texts.title: Tantrāloka (Abhinavagupta)
texts.notes: KSTS edition. Contains root verses + Jayaratha commentary interleaved. Dyczkowski English translation exists (11 vols).

texts.title: Tantrasāra (Abhinavagupta)
texts.notes: Abhinavagupta's own prose summary of Tantrāloka. English translation by H.N. Chakravarty (Rudra Press, 2012) available.

texts.title: Nyāyasūtra (Gautama)
texts.notes: 5 books, 65 sutras. Classical Nyāya foundation text.

texts.title: Nyāyabindu (Dharmakīrti)
texts.notes: 3 chapters, 209 sutras. Buddhist logic. Complex format — Motoi Ono database dump.

texts.title: Tarkasaṃgraha (Annaṃbhaṭṭa)
texts.notes: 76 numbered units. Analytic text with compound splits. Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika manual.

references.title: Vijñāna Bhairava (Swami Lakshmanjoo)
references.notes: 145 verses extracted from EPUB. Useful as VB reference.

references.title: Tantrasāra (H.N. Chakravarty translation)
references.notes: Complete English translation of Tantrasāra. For evaluation comparison only.

discovery_notes: All texts were found on GRETIL under sa_Author-work.txt patterns. Tarkasaṃgraha was initially thought to be unavailable as IAST, but was found at sa_annaMbhatta-tarkasaMgraha.txt. Always check GRETIL before OCRing.
